references.text: A man from each tribe was to help Moses with the census, just as a leader from each tribe was to assist with the allocation of the inheritance.
The leaders of Israel, heads of their ancestral houses, tribal princes who oversaw the numbering, brought gifts. This illustrates the role of tribal princes in important national tasks.
The preceding verse mentions Eleazar the priest and Joshua as the main leaders for the land distribution, and verse 18 continues by mentioning the tribal princes who were to assist them.
These verses list the names of the specific leaders from each tribe who were to help distribute the inherited land.
The fulfillment of the instruction in Numbers 34:18, where Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and the heads of the tribes distributed the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
The conclusion of the land distribution where Eleazar, Joshua, and the heads of the tribes completed the allocation of inheritances, as commanded in Numbers 34:18.
The heads of the Levites came to Eleazar, Joshua, and the tribal leaders to receive their cities, in accordance with the system described in Numbers 34:18.
